map.要更快增长需外部融资（增发/负债）或提 ROE/留存率；否则不可持续，会透支财务: Faster growth needs external financing (new equity or debt) or a higher ROE/retention ratio; otherwise it is unsustainable and drains the balance sheet.
map.这个公式有哪些隐含前提？: What Are the Hidden Assumptions of This Formula?
map.它假设资本结构不变、ROE 稳定且不增发新股。现实中 ROE 往往随规模扩大而回: It assumes a constant capital structure, a stable ROE, and no new share issuance. In reality ROE often declines as scale grows, so the actual growth rate is usually below the theoretical one; also note that if ROE is below the shareholders' required return, high book growth is actually destroying value.
